name: Fuyuu Toshi no Tsukurikata -Soratobu Fuuzoku Toshi Un'ei Hajimemashita!-
original_name: 浮遊都市の作り方-空飛ぶ風俗都市運営はじめました!-
source: Dissatisfied with the taxes the empire is imposing, Miru, the mayor of Tisryle, activates the engines beneath her city and takes to the skies! Not wanting other cities to follow her example, the council that rules the empire immediately sends their armies to destroy Tisryle. Miru must build her forces, recruit new allies, and most importantly, make a whole ton of money if she wants to stand a chance.
translation: 米露是提斯莱尔的市长，对帝国征收的税款感到不满，于是启动城市下方的引擎，让城市飞上天空！为了不让其他城市效仿，统治帝国的议会立即派军队摧毁提斯莱尔。米露必须建立自己的军队，招募新的盟友，更重要的是赚到一大笔钱，才有机会取胜。
